# component

`bots::component` integrates server-side bot movement, targeting, combat, cover seeking, health synchronization, and engine hooks, while `Entities` parses, serializes, filters, and mutates map entity dictionaries for conversion workflows.

## Contents

- [bots.cpp](./bots.cpp) defines `bots::component`, `bot_user_move_impl()`, target selection, visibility sampling, cover seeking, stuck recovery, health synchronization, and x86 engine-hook lifecycle methods.
- [entities.cpp](./entities.cpp) defines `Entities::Build()`, `Entities::parse()`, `Entities::GetModels()`, `Entities::ConvertVehicles()`, `Entities::ConvertTurrets()`, `Entities::DeleteOldSchoolPickups()`, and `Entities::AddRemovedSModels()`.
- [entities.hpp](./entities.hpp) declares `Entities`, its constructors, `entities` storage, `Build()`, `parse()`, `GetModels()`, `ConvertTurrets()`, `ConvertVehicles()`, `AddCarePackages()`, `AddRemovedSModels()`, and `DeleteOldSchoolPickups()`.

## Subdirectories

- [engine/](./engine/) contains console, mouse-input, patching, renderer, scripting, UX, and zone components.
- [gamepad/](./gamepad/) contains controller input, runtime, device, driver, mapping, calibration, sampling, transport, aim, and engine integration components.
- [utils/](./utils/) contains exception handling, resource interception, and scheduler components.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`bots::component::post_load()` resolves `SV_ClientThink`, hooks `client_enter_world_hook()`, replaces `SV_BotUserMove`, initializes `s_tracked_target`, and registers shutdown cleanup.

`sv_bot_user_move_hook()` obtains the client pointer, validates `CLIENT_ENTITYPTR_OFF`, and forwards valid clients to `bot_user_move_impl()`.

`bot_user_move_impl()` synchronizes bot health, selects visible or remembered targets, computes aim and movement commands, applies combat buttons, invokes `call_sv_client_think_real()`, and sanitizes health after native processing.

`Entities::parse()` converts quoted map text into `Entities::entities`, while `Entities::Build()` serializes dictionaries back into entity text.

`Entities::GetModels()`, `Entities::ConvertVehicles()`, `Entities::ConvertTurrets()`, and `Entities::DeleteOldSchoolPickups()` inspect or mutate `Entities::entities`.

## API Surface

`bots::component::post_load() override` installs bot hooks and shutdown state cleanup.

`bots::component::pre_destroy() override` restores overwritten engine instruction bytes.

`Entities::Build() -> std::string`, `Entities::GetModels() -> std::vector<std::string>`, `Entities::ConvertVehicles() -> bool`, `Entities::ConvertTurrets() -> bool`, and `Entities::DeleteOldSchoolPickups() -> void` define entity conversion operations.

`Entities::parse(std::string)` populates the public `entities` vector through parser states.

## Patterns

`REGISTER_COMPONENT(bots::component)` registers bot lifecycle behavior with the component loader.

`Entities::parse()` uses `PARSE_AWAIT_KEY`, `PARSE_READ_KEY`, `PARSE_AWAIT_VALUE`, and `PARSE_READ_VALUE` as quote-state sentinels.

`bot_state_index()` validates indices against `MAX_CLIENTS`, while `clear_bot_target_state()` resets per-client bot state.

## Behavioral Contracts

`CLIENT_STRIDE = 688916`, `CLIENT_ENTITYPTR_OFF = 0x2128C`, `CLIENT_LAST_USERCMD_OFF = 0x20E9C`, and `CLIENT_USERINFO_OFF = 1604` define client-memory layout.

`PS_ORIGIN_OFFSET = 0x20`, `PS_MAXHEALTH_OFFSET = 0x32C4`, and player-state health offset `0x1CC` define player-state fields.

`MAX_CLIENTS = 18`, `TARGET_MEMORY_MS = 5000`, `SEARCH_UPDATE_MS = 900`, `STUCK_REPATH_MS = 1400`, and `AIM_SETTLE_THRESHOLD = 1400` define bot-state and targeting lifetimes.

`FIRE_RANGE = 1400.0f`, `MELEE_RANGE = 96.0f`, `CROUCH_RANGE = 384.0f`, `SPRINT_RANGE = 700.0f`, and `STUCK_DIST_EPSILON = 24.0f` define movement and combat thresholds.

`Entities::Build()` emits `{\n`, `"key" "value"\n` pairs, and `}\n` without escaping embedded quotes or backslashes.

`Entities::parse()` lowercases keys, accepts `{` and `}` entity delimiters, and throws `std::runtime_error("Parsing error!")` for invalid quote-state transitions.

`get_info_value()` parses `\key\value` pairs, tolerates a leading backslash, compares keys with `_stricmp`, and returns the first matching value.

`parse_team_value()` recognizes `axis`, `1`, `axis`, `cell`, `enemy`, `allies`, `2`, `mi6`, `friendly`, `spectator`, `3`, `free`, `0`, and `none`.

`GetModels()` excludes models beginning with `*` or `?` and excludes exact `"com_plasticcase_green_big_us_dirt"`.

`DeleteOldSchoolPickups()` logs `Erased weapon %s from map ents\n` when erasing weapon entities.

`pre_destroy()` restores `E8 2B 5E D9 FF` at `game_offset(0x10414440)` and `83 EC 30 83 BE` at `SV_BotUserMove.get()`.

`__asm`, `__try`, `__except`, absolute game offsets, `CLIENT_STRIDE`, and raw structure offsets require a matching 32-bit Windows-compatible game binary.
